          POSTFIX_EXPR

              POSTFIX_EXPR
                POSTFIX_EXPR

                      IDENT "filter"

                      ARG

                            DOT "."
                            IDENT "age"

                    RPAREN ")"
                  DOT "."
                  IDENT "map"
